primary_conclusion.scope: Observed B11 coordinate footprint only; not proof of no biological relationship elsewhere.

endpoint: Any observed Fab heavy-atom contact across two complete OspC copies, unique eligible alignment sites; biological assembly1
limitations: Single antigen/reference and related, overlapping residues; no population significance or statistical independence.
Antibody contact at a fixed cutoff is not proof a residue is functionally necessary, antigenic across strains, or protective.
B11 and B5 footprints are biologically related and are not independent external validation sets.
D is a deterministic transform of agreement and NLL, not information beyond those components.
Features use panel means while antibodies bind a single experimental serotype; amino-acid/geometry controls and Q07337-specific NLL comparator address but do not remove confounding.
Blocked held-region performance is exploratory and penalty/splits are fixed, not optimized.
